description: This is a FastAPI-based REST API module for managing student attendance records, including features like creating, updating, deleting, listing, batch marking, and exporting attendance data as CSV. It utilizes SQLAlchemy ORM models and pydantic schemas, and integrates with authentication components.

classes.name: AttendanceCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating an attendance record, including student ID, class ID, date, and status.

classes.name: AttendanceUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating the attendance status.

classes.name: AttendanceOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for serializing attendance records when returned to clients, with configuration to fetch from ORM attributes.

classes.name: AttendanceMarkIn
classes.description: Pydantic model for bulk attendance marking, containing a list of AttendanceCreate entries.

methods.name: create_attendance(attendance: AttendanceCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new attendance record, prevents duplicate entries for the same student/class/date.

methods.name: mark_attendance(attendance_in: AttendanceMarkIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint for bulk marking of attendance for multiple students.

methods.name: list_attendance(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of all attendance records with optional pagination.

methods.name: get_attendance(attendance_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attendance record by its ID.

methods.name: update_attendance(attendance_id: int, att_in: AttendanceUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing attendance record.

methods.name: delete_attendance(attendance_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes an attendance record by ID.

methods.name: export_attendance_csv(class_id: Optional[int] = None, student_id: Optional[int] = None, start_date: Optional[date] = None, end_date: Optional[date] = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Exports filtered attendance records as a CSV file, supporting filtering by class_id, student_id, and date range.
